description: Review uncommitted changes (tracked diff plus new untracked files) for defects before commit.

spec.help: paths, or a phrase, stating what the change should do

context.help: extra files the reviewer may need, e.g. callers

request.objective: Find defects introduced by the change: the diff in diff.patch and the new files listed in untracked.txt.
criteria: Behaviour the change gets wrong relative to the source of truth
Callers or dependents of changed code that the change breaks
Crashes, data loss or state corruption on valid inputs
Requirements in the source of truth that the change does not implement
out_of_scope: Code the change does not touch, unless the change breaks it
request.notes: diff.patch is the output of git diff run in the working folder; its paths are relative to that folder. untracked.txt lists files not yet in git, one path per line relative to the working folder; review each as wholly new. Either may be empty.
